subject.title: [Feature]: Make Skill Workshop extensible for custom skill creation workflows

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class skill-creation authority/routing API, or should custom skill creators rely on explicit invocation and existing tool policy around `skill_workshop`?
rationale: The source gap is real, but choosing between a new hook, policy/config surface, or meta-skill workflow convention changes public plugin/tool semantics and cannot be settled safely by cleanup automation.

options.title: Design a narrow authority API
options.body: Add a maintainer-owned design for one pre-selection skill-creation authority path that composes with Skill Workshop proposal persistence and avoids a second write path.

options.title: Keep current explicit workflow model
options.body: Document that custom skill creators must be explicitly invoked or tool policy must hide `skill_workshop`, with no new core routing API.

options.title: Defer to meta-skill orchestration
options.body: Wait for the broader native meta-skill PR or successor design to prove this workflow before adding a separate Skill Workshop extension point.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow authority API
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-owned design for one pre-selection skill-creation authority path that composes with Skill Workshop proposal persistence and avoids a second write path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans product direction, bundled skill behavior, and current Skill Workshop routing carried in recent current-main history.
